parts.zh: M: 你决定想学什么了吗？
W: 是的，教授。我想学习建筑学
M: 啊，那是一门很棒的职业
W: 我认真思考了您在上次讨论中说的话
M: 这很好，不过我记得你之前一直在担心那些高深的数学
W: 不会。我做了一些网上调查
W: 嗯，我想这也是真的
M: 如今，建筑学是一门非常多样且充满活力的学位专业
W: 您觉得我应该先从哪种软件开始
M: Photoshop 是个不错的起点

items.stem: Why does the woman wish to study architecture?

choices.text: She is attracted to the beauty of modern buildings.
choices.zh: 她被现代建筑的美感所吸引。

choices.text: She is preoccupied with her dream to be an architect.
choices.zh: 她一心想着成为建筑师的梦想。

choices.text: She is influenced by her father who teaches architecture.
choices.zh: 她受到教授建筑学的父亲的影响。

choices.text: She is drawn to its integration of design and engineering.
choices.zh: 她被建筑学中设计与工程的结合所吸引。

items.stem: How does the woman say she will overcome the difficulty in learning mathematics?

choices.text: Through hard work.
choices.zh: 通过刻苦学习。

choices.text: With the professor's help.
choices.zh: 在教授的帮助下。

choices.text: By studying the subject online.
choices.zh: 通过在线学习该科目。

choices.text: By taking prerequisite courses.
choices.zh: 通过修读先修课程。

items.stem: What does the man say about architects' contribution to a city?

choices.text: It is groundbreaking.
choices.zh: 它是开创性的。

choices.text: It is long-lasting.
choices.zh: 它是持久的。

choices.text: It is immaterial.
choices.zh: 它是无关紧要的。

choices.text: It is immortal.
choices.zh: 它是不朽的。

items.stem: What subject does the man suggest the woman start with?

choices.text: Economics.
choices.zh: 经济学。

choices.text: Philosophy.
choices.zh: 哲学。

choices.text: Computer science.
choices.zh: 计算机科学。

choices.text: Western art.
choices.zh: 西方艺术。

items.stem: What do we learn from the conversation about Mr. Sanchez?

choices.text: He has occasionally been harassed by his fans.
choices.zh: 他偶尔会被粉丝骚扰。

choices.text: He has been guarded by a discreet assistant.
choices.zh: 他一直由一位谨慎的助理保护着。

choices.text: He is well known to the public.
choices.zh: 他为公众所熟知。

choices.text: He is a famous football coach.
choices.zh: 他是一位著名的足球教练。

items.stem: What will the man do if he gets the job?

choices.text: Serve as a personal assistant.
choices.zh: 担任私人助理。

choices.text: Play a key role in Real Madrid.
choices.zh: 在皇家马德里扮演关键角色。

choices.text: Run common daily chores for the woman.
choices.zh: 为女士处理日常琐事。

choices.text: Help promote Mr. Sanchez's public profile.
choices.zh: 帮助提升桑切斯先生的公众形象。

items.stem: What does the man say about himself?

choices.text: He is honest and always tells the truth.
choices.zh: 他诚实且总是说真话。

choices.text: He once worked part-time in university.
choices.zh: 他曾在大学期间做过兼职工作。

choices.text: He cares little about his working hours.
choices.zh: 他不太在意自己的工作时间。

choices.text: He has little previous work experience.
choices.zh: 他几乎没有以前的工作经验。

items.stem: Why does the man think he is a very competitive candidate?

choices.text: He has a strong ability to connect with people.
choices.zh: 他有很强的与人交往的能力。

choices.text: He has a high proficiency in several languages.
choices.zh: 他精通多种语言。

choices.text: He has a sound knowledge of sports consultancy.
choices.zh: 他对体育咨询有扎实的知识。

choices.text: He has a natural capacity to cooperate with others.
choices.zh: 他有与他人合作的天生能力。

items.stem: Why do extreme sports appeal to many kids?

choices.text: They bring more benefits to young people.
choices.zh: 它们给年轻人带来更多益处。

choices.text: They require less supervision and training.
choices.zh: 它们需要更少的监督和训练。

choices.text: They are more suitable to young people.
choices.zh: 它们更适合年轻人。

choices.text: They have fewer rules and pressures.
choices.zh: 它们有更少的规则和压力。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about risk-free activities?

choices.text: They prevent kids from enjoying adventure sports.
choices.zh: 它们阻止孩子享受冒险运动。

choices.text: They help kids guard against any possible injuries.
choices.zh: 它们帮助孩子防范任何可能的伤害。

choices.text: They rob kids of the chance to cultivate their courage.
choices.zh: 它们剥夺了孩子培养勇气的机会。

choices.text: They deprive kids of the opportunity to develop team spirit.
choices.zh: 它们剥夺了孩子发展团队精神的机会。

items.stem: What should parents do if they decide adventure sports are a bit too much for their kids?

choices.text: Help them take up these sports when they are more mature.
choices.zh: 在孩子更成熟时帮助他们从事这些运动。

choices.text: Let them participate in some less risky outdoor activities.
choices.zh: 让他们参与一些风险较小的户外活动。

choices.text: Ask them to try some forms of indoor sports.
choices.zh: 让他们尝试某些形式的室内运动。

choices.text: Introduce them to these sports step by step.
choices.zh: 循序渐进地向他们介绍这些运动。

items.stem: Why do new tech products soon become waste?

choices.text: Consumers often have a craving for the latest model.
choices.zh: 消费者往往渴望拥有最新款式。

choices.text: Such products tend to comprise parts that are irreplaceable.
choices.zh: 此类产品往往包含无法更换的部件。

choices.text: Tech firms intentionally design products to have short lifespans.
choices.zh: 科技公司有意将产品设计成使用寿命短的。

choices.text: Manufacturers use effective strategies to promote fancier products.
choices.zh: 制造商使用有效的策略来推广更华丽的产品。

items.stem: What did the French government require tech companies to do to help consumers make better choices?

choices.text: Indicate the competitiveness of their products.
choices.zh: 标明其产品的竞争力。

choices.text: List a repairability score of their products.
choices.zh: 列出其产品的可维修性评分。

choices.text: Specify the major parts of their products.
choices.zh: 详细说明其产品的主要部件。

choices.text: Detail the lifecycle of their products.
choices.zh: 详细说明其产品的生命周期。

items.stem: What should tech companies do to help ensure environmental sustainability?

choices.text: Take the initiative to reduce electronic waste.
choices.zh: 主动减少电子废弃物。

choices.text: Take due caution in upgrading their products.
choices.zh: 在升级其产品时采取适当的谨慎措施。

choices.text: Invest in constructing more recycling facilities.
choices.zh: 投资建设更多回收设施。

choices.text: Substitute all toxic substances with non-toxic ones.
choices.zh: 用无毒物质替代所有有毒物质。

items.stem: What does the speaker think of the problem of waste?

choices.text: It can be solved.
choices.zh: 它可以被解决。

choices.text: It is certain to worsen.
choices.zh: 它肯定会恶化。

choices.text: It will be fixed by tech companies.
choices.zh: 它将由科技公司解决。

choices.text: It is unavoidable in the long run.
choices.zh: 从长远来看它是不可避免的。

items.stem: What does most cyberloafing research focus on?

choices.text: How internet monitoring can be implemented.
choices.zh: 如何实施互联网监控。

choices.text: How to encourage productive internet surfing.
choices.zh: 如何鼓励富有成效的网络浏览。

choices.text: How cyberloafing affects overall productivity.
choices.zh: 网络闲逛如何影响整体生产力。

choices.text: How to prevent employees from cyberloafing.
choices.zh: 如何防止员工网络闲逛。

items.stem: What was the hypothesis of the speaker's research team?

choices.text: Cyberloafing is a sign of workers' laziness.
choices.zh: 网络闲逛是员工懒惰的标志。

choices.text: Cyberloafing may relieve employees of stress.
choices.zh: 网络闲逛可能缓解员工的压力。

choices.text: Employee engagement is closely related to job satisfaction.
choices.zh: 员工敬业度与工作满意度密切相关。

choices.text: Overuse of social media may lead to decline in productivity.
choices.zh: 过度使用社交媒体可能导致生产力下降。

items.stem: On what point do the results of the speaker's study agree with other recent research?

choices.text: Taking mini-breaks means better job performance.
choices.zh: 短暂休息意味着更好的工作表现。

choices.text: Cyberloafing generally does more harm than good.
choices.zh: 网络闲逛总体上弊大于利。

choices.text: Worker turnover is linked to the time allowed for cyberloafing.
choices.zh: 员工流动率与允许网络闲逛的时间有关。

choices.text: Employees who indulge in internet surfing are most likely to quit.
choices.zh: 沉溺于网络浏览的员工最有可能辞职。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Nebraska City in 1854 when Julius Morton moved there?

choices.text: There were no wooden buildings.
choices.zh: 没有木制建筑。

choices.text: There were environmental problems.
choices.zh: 存在环境问题。

choices.text: There were no trees.
choices.zh: 没有树木。

choices.text: There were few settlers.
choices.zh: 几乎没有定居者。

items.stem: What did Julius Morton do that increased his influence in Nebraska City?

choices.text: He served as chairman of the Nebraska State Board of Agriculture.
choices.zh: 他担任Nebraska州农业委员会主席。

choices.text: He urged the state to start the Nebraska State Gardening Society.
choices.zh: 他敦促该州成立Nebraska州园艺协会。

choices.text: He engaged himself in a large number of aesthetic projects.
choices.zh: 他参与了大量美化项目。

choices.text: He founded a newspaper and used it to promote his ideas.
choices.zh: 他创办了一份报纸并用它来宣传他的理念。

items.stem: What does the speaker say happened on April 10, 1872?

choices.text: A special prize was awarded to Julius Morton.
choices.zh: Julius Morton获得了一项特别奖励。

choices.text: One million trees were planted throughout Nebraska.
choices.zh: 整个Nebraska州种植了一百万棵树。

choices.text: The state government declared it the official Arbor Day.
choices.zh: 州政府宣布这一天为正式的植树节。

choices.text: Nebraska earned the nickname "the Tree Planters State".
choices.zh: Nebraska获得了"植树者之州"的昵称。

items.stem: What do we learn about modern humans according to the hypothesis commonly accepted in the 1990s?

choices.text: They spread across Europe and Asia in a few decades.
choices.zh: 他们在几十年内遍布欧洲和亚洲。

choices.text: They lived mostly in Africa for about 200,000 years.
choices.zh: 他们在非洲生活了大约20万年。

choices.text: They preferred to live in Europe rather than in Asia.
choices.zh: 他们更喜欢生活在欧洲而不是亚洲。

choices.text: They moved out of Africa about 60,000 years ago.
choices.zh: 他们大约在6万年前走出非洲。

items.stem: What has called into question the "Out of Africa" model?

choices.text: The discovery of two modern human teeth in China.
choices.zh: 在中国发现的两颗现代人类牙齿。

choices.text: The traces of human migration out of Africa to Asia.
choices.zh: 人类从非洲迁徙到亚洲的痕迹。

choices.text: The human fossils discovered most recently in Africa.
choices.zh: 最近在非洲发现的人类化石。

choices.text: The Luna cave in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.
choices.zh: 广西壮族自治区的Luna洞穴。

items.stem: What does the speaker want to show with the example of some monkeys in Africa?

choices.text: There must have been some reason for human migration.
choices.zh: 人类迁徙一定有某种原因。

choices.text: There have been changes in animals' living conditions.
choices.zh: 动物的生存条件发生了变化。

choices.text: Humans adapted themselves to the environment there.
choices.zh: 人类在那里适应了环境。

choices.text: Humans had access to abundant food sources there.
choices.zh: 人类在那里能获得丰富的食物来源。

items.stem: What question does the speaker raise close to the end of the talk?

choices.text: How humans settled down on the Arabian Peninsula.
choices.zh: 人类如何在阿拉伯半岛定居。

choices.text: When modern humans started to disperse out of Africa.
choices.zh: 现代人类何时开始走出非洲。

choices.text: What path modern humans took to migrate out of Africa.
choices.zh: 现代人类走出非洲采取了什么路径。

choices.text: Why fresh water is so important for human survival.
choices.zh: 淡水对人类生存为何如此重要。
